description: Bus Routes - New Network July 2020 is a dataset listed in ACT Government open data portal (www.data.act.gov.au), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by ACT Government. This dataset provides the shape file of physical paths taken by vehicles in the ACT. This file is generated using the GTFS data as of July 2020. Please refer to latest GTFS data published at. Coverage: Australian Capital Territory. The portal files it under the category Transport. Its tags are routes, shape file, transport. The table has 12 columns. Attribution on the portal: TC. The portal shows 2020-07-10 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-act-gov-au-portal.
